title: His wedding guests gave $6k to fund a health startup. Now it's won a $3 million prize
description: Dr. Raj Panjabi founded Last Mile Health to bring healthcare to people living in remote areas. The group is the 2026 recipient of the Conrad N. Hilton Humanitarian Prize.
